about: Christopher R. Kaup is an attorney who represents clients in the Phoenix, Arizona area. Christopher Kaup is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Christopher Kaup chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Pennsylvania Law School and graduated in 1991. Christopher Kaup passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1991.
He represents clients with Bankruptcy: Business issues in Arizona.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Christopher Kaup has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
